detail.longDescription: Inside PH4NTXM: #52 PH4NTXM Vault A disposable session can still produce files you choose to keep. Vault collects explicitly selected files in private RAM and exports an encrypted .ph4vault bundle with a separate passphrase. Source files remain unchanged. Only ciphertext is written to the chosen destination. Encryption uses age’s passphrase mode with ChaCha20-Poly1305 and scrypt. Encryption and decryption run in a separate sandboxed worker with network isolation, memory limits, zero swap and a deadline. Passphrases travel through a private pipe, outside command arguments, environment variables and logs. Existing vaults unlock manually into RAM. Supported files can be reviewed through Airlock and isolated viewers. Opening existing vaults and reviewing files require KVM. Lock or normal Close removes the temporary session files. Exported encrypted copies remain available for later use. Vault does not automatically save or restore operating system settings, browser profiles or session identities. # ph4ntxm # linux # debian # os # live # privacy # security # opsec # infosec # research # tech # technology
